cl.x: Provide Sika® Air - LS where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).

Sika® Air-LS is an air-entraining agent based on synthetic surfactants. It is a diluted version of Sika® Air and therefore performs and fulfils the same function as Sika® Air but at higher dose rates, to enable more accurate dosing. Its efficiency is based upon the entrainment into the mix of a high number of correctly sized and evenly distributed air bubbles.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Sika® Air LS is used to
cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Uses > Sika® Air LS is used to
s: Improve resistance to freeze-thaw cycles in hardened concrete;
Increase cohesion, reducing the concrete tendency to bleed and segregate;
Improve compaction of low workability mixes including semi-dry concrete.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: Typical dosage rates for general concrete production range from 250-750 mls per cubic metre of concrete. For low slump concrete (<65 mm slump) and pavement type concrete, particularly concrete that contains high volume of fly ash, substantially higher dose rate of Sika Air LS may be required to achieve the desired air content. Typical dose rates for high volume fly ash or low slump concrete range from 500-3000 ml per cubic metre of concrete.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
